```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(glue)
library(mvtnorm)
library(pracma)
library(here)

source(here("mogp-utils.R"))
```

The purpose of this notebook is to generate draws from a multi-output spectral mixture Gaussian process with known hyperparameter values:

- $w_i$: magnitude/weight
- $\Sigma_i$: spectral width/variance
- $\mu_i$: spectral frequency/mean
- $\theta_i$: delay
- $\phi_i$: phase


```{r}
D <- 2
Q <- 1
num_points <- 100

pct_missing <- 0.2
noise_sigma <- 0.1

i <- 1
while(i <= 20) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      SEED <- round(runif(1, min = 0, max = 99999))
      output <- simulate_Q1_moskgp(D, num_points, noise_sigma, seed = SEED, masked_pct = pct_missing)
      break
    },
    warning = function(cnd) {
      cat("Warning:", i, "Seed:", SEED, conditionMessage(cnd), "\n")
    },
    finally = {
      i <- i + 1
    }
  )
}
cat("i =",i-1, "Seed =", SEED, "\n")

output_params <- output[[1]]
output_df <- output[[2]]

output_params
```

```{r}
output_df |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = t, y = y, alpha = ifelse(masked, 0.2, 1), colour = d) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = paste("Seed =", output_params$seed), alpha = "Observed", colour = "Band") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
output_filename_stub <- glue("D{D}-Q{Q}-seed{SEED}-n{num_points}-mcar{pct_missing}-sigma{noise_sigma}")

df_output_filename <- glue("{output_filename_stub}-sim.csv")
param_output_filename <- glue("{output_filename_stub}-param.tsv")

write_csv(
  output_df |>
    filter(!masked) |> 
    select(-masked), 
  here("data", df_output_filename)
)

write_tsv(
  output_params, 
  here("data", param_output_filename)
)
```
